title: Embeddings + Rerank Starter Labs: Microflow Tiles & Snapshot Gallery
creator: Maya Chen
screenshot_specs: Primary pipeline diagram: 1400x700 PNG, annotation layer separated (labels as text), light + dark variants
Microflow tile state variants: 480x320 cards (empty, live-run, rerank-high-confidence, rerank-low-confidence)
Sample outputs gallery: 1200x800 with token count overlay and truncated vector preview (3 items)
Accessibility keyboard-focus walkthrough: GIF 800x600 showing tabflow and ARIA labels
Mobile crop set: 390x844 for iPhone / 360x800 for Android (cards scaled)
description: Goal: Produce a compact starter-labs visual set that teaches new users how to run embeddings + rerank pipelines in the Console and SDK. Deliverables: 1) Microflow Tiles UI (empty -> run -> rerank results) with annotated callouts and copy; 2) Pipeline diagram that explains indexing, embedding vectors, and rerank step with fallback policy; 3) Snapshot gallery of sample outputs using 'kb-sample' dataset (3 query examples: FAQ search, long-doc snippet, support ticket triage); 4) Export-ready assets in light/dark modes and localized copy for en-US and fr-FR. Acceptance criteria: visuals approved by PM and Eng, pass 4.5:1 contrast check for primary CTAs, include alt text for all screenshots, and final PNGs exported at requested resolutions. Notes: choose concise copy to fit tiles; ensure rerank confidence band is visualized as color + numeric score; truncate vector preview to 3 nearest neighbors to avoid cognitive overload.
